reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Formation of company and contents of articles of association
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and notes (RSMo 1939 § 5126, A.L. 1951 p. 545). Covers authorization for five or more persons to form railroad corporation and mandatory contents of articles of association, including corporate name, duration, route, per-mile capital stock minimums, and 5 to 21 initial directors.

headings.title: Subscription requirements for articles of association
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2. Requires each subscriber to sign articles of association stating name, place of residence, and number of shares of stock taken.

headings.title: Filing with secretary of state and corporate powers
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3. Provides for filing articles of association with secretary of state upon compliance with section 388.040, recording by secretary, and creation of body corporate with statutory powers and privileges.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 3 subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5126, A.L. 1951 p. 545). Confirmed all 3 draft titles for railroad incorporation, articles contents, subscriptions, and secretary of state filing.

headings.title: Stock subscription and payment prerequisites for filing
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and notes (RSMo 1939 § 5135; cross reference 351.065). Prohibits filing until required per-mile stock is subscribed with 5% cash paid to directors and verified by affidavit of at least three directors.

headings.title: Capital stock fees payable to state treasury
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2. Specifies required payment into state treasury of fifty dollars for first fifty thousand dollars capital stock plus five dollars per additional ten thousand dollars before filing and recording.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5135; § 351.065 cross-ref). Confirmed draft titles for per-mile subscription/5% cash/affidavit prerequisites and state treasury capital stock fees.

headings.title: Prohibited interests in materials, supplies, and carrier business
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and notes (RSMo 1939 § 5231). Prohibits railroad presidents, directors, officers, agents, or employees from having direct or indirect interest in furnishing supplies to company or operating as common carrier over company's works.

headings.title: Misdemeanor penalty for unlawful officer or employee interests
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2. Imposes misdemeanor fine of two hundred to one thousand dollars, county jail term of three months to one year, or both, treating each day's violation as separate offense.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5231). Confirmed draft titles prohibiting officer/employee supply or common-carrier interests and setting misdemeanor fine/jail penalties.

headings.title: Authority and permitted subjects for amending articles
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and notes (L. 1945 p. 686 § 5149; Loeb dividend interpleader annotation). Authorizes railroad corporations to amend articles within original lawful limits, detailing ten specific permitted changes including name, duration, purposes, directors (3-21), and share classes.

headings.title: Board resolution, notice, and shareholder voting requirements
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2. Prescribes procedure for adopting amendments by board resolution, notice under section 351.230, and shareholder vote, including special approval thresholds for share increases, preferential shares, and adverse class alterations.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (L. 1945 p. 686 § 5149; 1958 Loeb dividend interpleader annotation). Confirmed draft titles for permitted charter amendments (10 subdivisions) and board/shareholder voting procedures.

headings.title: Reorganization amendments under confirmed federal bankruptcy plan
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and notes (L. 1945 p. 684 § 5289C). Grants reorganization managers or court-authorized persons power to adopt charter amendments to execute confirmed federal bankruptcy reorganization plan without director or stockholder action.

headings.title: Execution and filing of certificate of amendment
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2. Requires filing sworn certificate of amendment with secretary of state showing corporate name, adopted amendments, new capitalization, and federal court confirmation details.

headings.title: Preservation of future amendment rights and capital fees
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3. Confirms reorganized railroad may further amend charter under general law and requires payment of prescribed state fees on capital stock increases over previous authorized capital.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 3 subsections and source notes (L. 1945 p. 684 § 5289C). Confirmed draft titles for National Bankruptcy Act reorganization charter amendments, sworn certificate filing, and preserved amendment rights/capital fees.

headings.title: Consolidation agreement for continuous line of railroad
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and notes (RSMo 1939 § 5161). Authorizes continuous-line railroads to consolidate into one company subject to all rights and obligations, upon agreement approved by majority of stock of each company.

headings.title: Filing articles of agreement with secretary of state
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2. Directs filing certified copy of articles of agreement with secretary of state, which constitutes conclusive evidence of completed consolidation.

headings.title: Stock issuance and prohibitions on noncontinuous or anticompetitive mergers
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3. Authorizes boards to call in and reissue stock under consolidated name; expressly conditions consolidation on securing continuous line in same general direction and prohibits mergers depriving public of competition.

headings.title: Void consolidations and circuit court injunctive actions
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4. Declares nonconforming consolidations void and authorizes any aggrieved party or stockholder to bring suit in circuit court to restrain unlawful consolidation.

headings.title: Through freight transit rights for intersecting railroads
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 5. Grants intersecting railroads right to run freight cars over consolidated road without breaking bulk, requiring consolidated road to transact business on fair and reasonable terms.

headings.title: Stockholder meeting notice and acceptance resolution filing
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 6. Requires each consolidating company to file resolution accepting section provisions after approval by majority stockholder vote following sixty days published notice.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 6 subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5161). Confirmed all 6 draft titles covering continuous-line railroad consolidation, filing, anticompetitive bar, circuit court injunction, intersecting freight rights, and 60-day stockholder acceptance.

headings.title: Authority to aid, lease, purchase, or extend railroads
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and notes (RSMo 1939 § 5162; Hayman personal injury jurisdiction note). Authorizes railroad companies to aid connectable lines, extend into adjoining states, purchase or lease continuous lines, and authorizes foreign railroads to operate in Missouri.

headings.title: Stockholder assent and filing requirements for agreements
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2. Conditions aid, purchase, lease, or consolidation on approval by majority of stock after sixty days notice and filing certificate with secretary of state.

headings.title: Taxation, concurrent liability, and process agent office
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3. Subjects foreign railroad property in state to taxation and state laws; establishes concurrent liability of domestic lessor and foreign lessee, and mandates maintaining in-state office for service of process.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 3 subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5162; 1955 Hayman v. Southern Pac. Co. annotation). Confirmed draft titles for railroad aid/lease/purchase/extension, 60-day stockholder assent, and foreign-railroad taxation, liability, and process office.

headings.title: Successor liability and continued lessor or licensor liability
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and notes (RSMo 1939 § 5163). Imposes liability on purchasers, transferees, or lessees for existing judgments, claims, and debts, and preserves lessor/licensor liability for acts of lessee or licensee.

headings.title: Permissive joinder of parties and common service of process
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2. Permits claimants to sue either or both transferor and transferee corporations, add transferees in pending actions, and treat employees and offices of either as valid agents for service on both.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5163). Confirmed draft titles for transferee/lessor debt liability and permissive joinder with shared service of process.

headings.title: Entry for materials, agreed damages, and commissioner appraisal
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and notes (RSMo 1939 § 5160, A.L. 1990 H.B. 1070). Authorizes railroads to take construction materials and water from neighboring land, paying agreed damages or applying to associate circuit judge for three disinterested commissioners with ten days notice and appeal to circuit court.

headings.title: Penalty for official neglect and prepayment before entry
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2. Imposes penalty up to twenty-five dollars on judge or resident refusing duties and prohibits entry, disturbance, or title divestiture until assessed damages are paid to owner or deposited in court.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5160, A.L. 1990 H.B. 1070). Confirmed draft titles for taking construction materials/water with 3-commissioner appraisal and $25 neglect forfeiture/prepayment prerequisite.

headings.title: Director two-thirds vote for roadbed change or extension
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and notes (RSMo 1939 § 5150). Authorizes board by two-thirds vote to change roadbed or line for shortening or economy, and to extend line from terminus when subscribed and paid capital meets statutory mile thresholds.

headings.title: Change of gauge requirements, fees, and route restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2. Authorizes gauge changes between narrow and standard gauge with specific capital and cash payment thresholds and treasury fees; prohibits altering general route or established termini except by extension.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5150). Confirmed draft titles for two-thirds director vote on roadbed changes/extensions and gauge-change capital, filing, and route-preservation rules.

headings.title: Formation and articles of union depot corporation
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and notes (RSMo 1939 § 5251). Authorizes five or more persons and railroad companies to incorporate union passenger or freight depot company with capital up to ten million dollars and five to twenty directors.

headings.title: Railroad authority to build and operate union stations
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2. Authorizes any railroad company to construct, maintain, and operate union passenger or freight stations with same powers possessed by union depot companies.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5251). Confirmed draft titles for union depot corporation formation (up to $10M capital, 5–20 directors) and direct railroad union station authority.
